name.description: the leaderboard's own name, e.g. Chatbot Arena (LMArena)

maintainer.description: who runs it, as the source names them

tagline.description: one line saying what the board is for

ranks.description: what the board ranks, in a few words, e.g. chat models by human preference

benchmarks.description: IDs of the benchmark records the board reports

update_cadence.description: how often the board changes: Irregular (it changes with no stated rhythm), Retired (it no longer changes), Not stated (the source gives no rhythm). A new rhythm is added here before a record uses it

coverage.description: how many models or votes the board covers, as the source states it

free_access.description: true when the board is free to read

score_origin.description: whether the scores come from the vendors themselves, from the board's own runs, or from both
